course_name: Course Intro: Entrepreneurial Myths & Entrepreneurial Mindset
Module 1: Start with What Matters - Problem Definition
course_description: In Module 1, you’ll shift your focus from chasing big ideas to deeply understanding real problems—starting with empathy, curiosity, and your own lived experiences. You’ll learn how to define a meaningful problem, reflect on your personal values and strengths, and lay a strong foundation for building a venture that’s not only innovative, but deeply rooted in what matters most.

course_name: Module 2: From Problems to Possibilities - Ideation
course_description: Once you’ve identified a problem worth solving, it’s time to explore solutions. The goal of this module is to unleash your creativity and generate as many ideas as possible—even the wild ones. In entrepreneurship, it’s not about getting it “right” on the first try. It’s about thinking boldly, pushing boundaries, and then narrowing down the most promising directions to prototype and test. So why does ideation matter?

course_name: Module 3: Market Testing for Your Idea - Prototyping
course_description: Now that you’ve defined your problem and identified your most promising ideas, it’s time to bring your concept to life—quickly, simply, with the intention to learn. When we think about building something new, our first instinct might be to make it perfect right from the start. But in the world of entrepreneurship, that often could be a recipe for wasted time and effort. This is where prototyping comes in, and it's less about building a polished product and more about a strategic mindset.

course_name: Module 4: Storytelling Your Prototype and Build Your Business Model Canvas
course_description:
Now that you have something concrete to show, it’s time to get out there and present your prototype to the world! You will learn how to share your business idea to different stakeholders such as your potential customers, partners or team members, which will allow you to get real-life feedback and suggestions to improve your prototype and idea. 

This is a critical phase in your entrepreneurial journey to understand your customer pain points and needs of the market as well as attract partners, team members or investors!

With all these new market insights, you will be able to improve your business idea and start refining your business model, which means how you can monetize your idea and run your business in a sustainable manner, while adding value to your customers.

course_name: Module 5: Building a Team That Can Build the Dream
course_description: Launching an initiative—whether it’s a business, nonprofit, or community project—is not a solo journey. Behind every impactful venture is not just a great idea, but a great team. Your founding team shapes your solution, defines your culture, and sets the tone for everything that follows. The skills you don’t have yet? You’ll need to find them. The gaps in your thinking? You’ll need to fill them—with people who challenge you, complement you, and build alongside you. In this module, we’ll explore how to build a strong, values-aligned team by understanding your leadership style, identifying skill gaps, and complementing your strengths with the right collaborators. You’ll also learn how to foster collective creativity—designing a team culture that sparks innovation, trust, and shared ownership from the very beginning.

course_name: Module 6: Finding Available Support in Your Ecosystem
course_description:
Entrepreneurship is a difficult journey, full of ups and downs. But you will not be alone! Wherever you are, you can find plenty of organizations or individuals who stand ready to support you. It takes a village to raise a child, it also takes an ecosystem to raise a business!

In this module, you will understand the 6 components that make an entrepreneurship ecosystem and what kind of support is available for your business. You will also hear from entrepreneurship-support organizations about what they do. 

Finally, you will discover the Pitch Deck template, a powerful framework to introduce your business in a comprehensive manner. While the Elevator Pitch that you saw in Module 4 is a very quick presentation, the Pitch Deck will guide you to introduce your business the best way to any ecosystem partner in order to mobilize support and bring your business to the next level.

course_name: Module 0: Welcome - this is not your typical course
course_description: Module 0 sets the stage for your confident speaking journey by exploring why communication is the #1 skill for career and personal growth. You’ll meet Rae, your instructor, and discover how owning your voice is about aligning your inner confidence with your outer expression. The module also outlines what to expect from the course, introduces key mindsets for success, and helps you set clear intentions to track your growth.

course_name: Module 1: Overcome Your Fear of Public Speaking
course_description: Module 1 helps learners understand and manage the root causes of their fear of public speaking, recognizing it as a natural response. It explores common fears such as past failures, fear of judgment, and negative authority experiences, guiding participants through self-reflection and mindset shifts to build self-trust. The lesson ends with an action plan to set clear speaking goals and take small, confidence-building steps toward becoming a more empowered communicator.

course_name: Module 2: The Secret to Impactful Communication
course_description: Module 2 introduces the three pillars of persuasive speaking—ethos (credibility), pathos (emotional connection), and logos (logic)—based on Aristotle’s timeless framework. Learners reflect on how to apply these pillars to connect with their audience, support their message, and communicate with purpose. A core practice, the Daily Insight, helps build creativity and self-awareness by encouraging consistent reflection through storytelling prompts and expressive writing.

Module 3 guides you through a clear, structured method to craft impactful presentations—from brainstorming objectives and understanding your audience, to delivering with persuasive clarity using the 3 pillars (ethos, pathos, logos). It emphasizes planning your audience’s journey (from their current mindset to your desired outcome) while incorporating stories, interactivity, and emotional resonance to make your message memorable. Your weekly task is to apply this framework to design and deliver a short 5–10 minute presentation using the tools and templates provided.

course_name: Module 4: Master the Art of Storytelling
course_description: Module 4 emphasizes how storytelling builds deep emotional connections, evokes empathy, and enhances credibility—helping others root for you before you even begin. Through “story mining,” you reflect on personal experiences (joys, struggles, growth moments) to uncover meaningful stories that can support your career, advocacy, or message with emotional resonance and authenticity. This week’s task is to craft one personal story using the framework to connect with your audience and reinforce your message or mission.

Module 5 teaches that your mindset and intentional use of voice significantly impact how confidently and effectively you communicate. By tapping into different vocal “characters”—Leader, Counsellor, Entertainer—and applying vocal variety techniques like tone, pace, pause, and emphasis, you can align your delivery with your audience’s desired thoughts, feelings, and actions. This week’s task is to practice delivering your story from Module 4 using this voice-shaping framework to intentionally influence your audience’s experience.

course_name: Module 6: Own Your Voice as a Way of Life
course_description: Module 6 invites you to reflect on your journey and commit to integrating your voice work into daily life. It encourages you to continue the Daily Insight practice using creative “plays” to strengthen your inner voice and expression across all areas of life. The lesson wraps up with powerful prompts and curated resources to help you sustain momentum, deepen self-awareness, and apply your voice with purpose in relationships, work, and personal growth.

Module 7 emphasizes that public speaking is a powerful tool for advocacy, requiring a strong voice, clarity of message, storytelling, and relationship-building to drive meaningful change. Your most authentic advocacy message stems from personal experiences and deep emotions, and connecting with the right audience means creating a shared world grounded in specific values and lived realities. The lesson encourages reflection, intentional communication, and collaboration to influence hearts, shift perspectives, and build a better future through your voice.

course_name: Module 8: Public Speaking for Branding and Job Readiness
course_description: Module 8 emphasizes the importance of building a personal brand as a way to stand out in today’s competitive, AI-driven world, whether in the workplace or job market. Your brand is shaped by your presence, identity, voice, and story—how people experience you and what you consistently stand for. The lesson also provides tools to prepare for interviews, share your story confidently, and advocate for yourself by aligning your communication and mindset with your personal brand.

course_name: Module 9: Public Speaking for Young Entrepreneurs
course_description: Module 9 highlights how strong public speaking skills are essential for young social entrepreneurs to inspire action, secure resources, and build a credible brand. It outlines key elements of a strong pitch—compelling openings, clear value propositions, emotional storytelling, proven traction, and confident delivery—while warning against common mistakes like being overly technical or neglecting stories. Finally, it emphasizes crafting a powerful brand story and showcasing client transformations using storytelling frameworks to emotionally connect with audiences and demonstrate impact.

In this module, you will be introduced to key concepts related to climate change and green jobs. This module will help you "spot the challenge" of climate change and understand how you can act on your climate concerns through your career decisions. By the end of this module, you will be ready to move onto Module 2: Listen to Yourself.

In this module, you will build on what you learned in Module 1: Spot the Challenge and learn about the skills necessary for green jobs. You will think critically about how these green skills apply to different jobs and to your own life. By the end of the module, you will have reflected on which green skills you already possess and which you would like to keep building, preparing you to advance to Module 3: Find Youth Path.

In this module, you will build on what you've learned in Modules 1 and 2 and be introduced to an array of green career paths across different sectors by attending a Virtual Green Job Career Fair. The goal of this module is to give you a sense of the possibilities that lie ahead as you embark on your green career path. You will reflect on and assess what career paths most interest you and align with your skillset and values. By the end of this module, you will be ready to move on to Module 4: Consider the Bigger Picture. ​

In this module, you will build on what you've learned in the first half of the course to connect green jobs to broader systems of change, exploring how all 17 of the Sustainable Development Goals are relevant to green jobs and a green transition. The goal of this module is to broaden your perspective of green jobs toward seeing how all jobs can be green jobs. By the end of this module, you will be ready to move on to Module 5: Unlock Your Inner Entrepreneur.

In this module, you will learn how you can bring your personal skills, interests, and values to whatever green job you decide to take on, adopting an entrepreneurial spirit in how you live and work more sustainably. The goal of this module is to prompt reflection on your own values and how they may align with your green career path and to introduce you to the work that green entrepreneurs around the world are doing, building their skills, following their interests, and working in alignment with their values while contributing to sustainable development. By the end of this module, you will be ready to move on to the final module of this course, Module 6: Build Your Green Career.

In this module, you will complete a Green New Careers quiz from the Sunrise Movement, and then learn about the different green career paths that may suit you best. The goal of this module is to bring together all you have learned about green jobs and yourself throughout this course. Thus, you will finish the course feeling confident and excited about finding the right green career path for you. By the end of this module, you will have a better idea of the types of green jobs out there that match your interests and working styles, and you will be ready to apply all you've learned in this course to the real world!
